description: Iranian strikes damaged one A-10 Thunderbolt II and eight F-15s this week on the Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan.

title: Pentagon awards contract in race to field cheaper interceptors, missiles
description: The Pentagon awarded a contract to X-Bow Systems in its race to develop a new anti-ballistic weapon for less than $750,000 per shot.

title: Yemen’s Houthis claim strikes on ‘sensitive sites' in Saudi Arabia
description: A Houthi spokesman on Saturday said the Yemeni militia launched missile and drone strikes on "sensitive sites" in Saudi Arabia, including the kingdom's port city of Yanbu and the capital Riyadh. The statement came hours after residents and journalists said they saw a thick plume of black smoke and flames rising from the area near the Riyadh King Khalid International Airport.

title: French outpost off Canada in the spotlight as Macron hosts Carney on symbolic visit
description: President Emmanuel Macron embarked Saturday on a symbolic visit to Saint Pierre and Miquelon, a French territory off Canada's Newfoundland, where he hosts Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney. The first-ever visit by a Canadian prime minister to the French archipelago in the North Atlantic comes as Carney marks a shift in Ottawa's foreign policy toward Europe amid growing tensions with the US.

title: Iran says conditions to re-engage in talks, end war sent to US via Qatar
description: Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, tells Al Jazeera Tehran awaiting Trump response.

title: Israel targets paramedics in southern Lebanon
description: Two back-to-back Israeli air strikes hit Nabatieh in Lebanon, while a third strike targeted an ambulance team.

title: A four-minute warning isn't enough: Russia's new relentless missile tactics exhaust Kyiv residents
description: Increasingly frequent and ferocious attacks on the Ukrainian capital have left many on edge.

title: Houthis claim attack on Saudi capital after smoke seen rising near Riyadh airport
description: The King Khalid International Airport incident caused hours of flight disruptions and comes amid an escalating conflict with Houthi rebels in Yemen.

title: In Significant Escalation, Houthis Claim Attacks on Saudi Capital
description: The Houthis, an Iranian-backed militia, said they had fired a wave of missiles and drones at Riyadh, where residents reported explosions, and on Saudi oil facilities. Saudi Arabia has not commented on the claims.

title: Россия возглавила рейтинг самых кошачьих стран в мире
description: Россия возглавила рейтинг стран по доле семей, имеющих кошек в качестве домашних питомцев. Список опубликовал портал Seasia Stats.

description: LONDON: The US military has helped 1 billion barrels of oil leave the Arabian Gulf in the “last couple of months,” the head of American forces in the region said on Saturday. description: JOHANNESBURG: South Africans gathered for memorial runs and protests this week after the killings of nine women near Johannesburg reignited anger and fear over violence that many say mirrors the dangers women face every day. description: TBILISI: A former Russian federal official has been elected president of South Ossetia, a Russia-backed breakaway region of Georgia, in a vote Moscow hailed on Saturday as a sign of the territory’s desire for closer ties with Moscow. title: Russia cannot sway French through ‘intimidation’, Le Pen says
description: Marine Le Pen and National Rally chief Jordan Bardella assert that Russian intimidation will not influence French policies, condemning Russia’s actions as ‘hostile’. Le Pen is currently a leading contender in the upcoming French presidential election.
